gaps.explanation: Statement debt_proceeds 2,970,757 = p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Other Financing Sources: Leases Total 1,843,848 (General 1,816,773 + Health Center 8,335 + Nonmajor 18,740) + Subscription Total 1,126,909 (General 1,022,024 + Nonmajor 104,885). Detail has only the Nonmajor amounts, from the p12 combining statement (Health Department Fund): index 159 'Lease' 18,740 and index 160 'Subscriptions' 104,885. The General Fund and Health Center budget-basis schedules (p8 General Fund other financing prints only Transfers in / out; p10 Health Center prints only Transfers in) do not print the lease / subscription proceeds, so the General and Health Center amounts are missing from detail. Added from the p6 fund columns: General Leases 1,816,773, General Subscription 1,022,024, Health Center Leases 8,335 (sum 2,847,132). Arithmetic: schedule_total 18,740 + 2,847,132 = 2,865,872; the remaining 104,885 is the existing index 160 'Subscriptions' line, which is in detail but not counted in schedule_gap.csv's schedule_total because its label has none of the words bond/loan/note/proceed/issuance/warrant/lease. Detail after the fix: 18,740 + 104,885 + 1,816,773 + 1,022,024 + 8,335 = 2,970,757 = statement. (The two 'Subscriptions' lines will still not be counted by the gap check's label filter; the money is complete.)
